description: The receipts for one attribution row: the actual orders (date, buyer, amount net of refunds, status) that get_attribution_report counted under a given source / campaign / ad. Use it when the seller asks 'which orders?' or doubts a number — an aggregate is only as trustworthy as the ability to check it, and this uses the identical filters and attribution as the report, so it always reconciles. Returns up to 50 newest plus the true total. Rebills are not listed (they belong to the origin order's LTV). Requires the Trace subscription.

ad.description: Narrow to the row's ad (utm_content; pass '(none)' for the untagged row)

campaign.description: Narrow to the row's campaign (required to match a campaign-level row)

days.description: Must match the window the report was read with

source.description: The row's source, exactly as the report shows it (e.g. 'kit', 'meta')

touch.description: Must match the report's attribution setting

name: get_orders_behind
title: The orders behind a report row (Trace)
